prompt_text: Analyze Prompt664 long-running daemon acceptance and propose the next bounded local-only prompt for unattended acceptance. Preserve all safety constraints: no remote push, no PR creation, no merge, no destructive cleanup, no credential/cookie/browser-profile/.env/private-session access, and no arbitrary free-text prompt execution. Focus on explicit operator controls, bounded unattended runtime, evidence retention, health/status reporting, and fail-closed recovery.
